values.note: Single site $20 a night, plus $7 for an electric hookup ($27); double sites $40 / $54. Senior/Access pass halves only the campsite fee on single sites, not the electric fee.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/arrowhead-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night', 'Double Site: $40 per night', 'Singe Site electric hook-up fee: $7 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233910/rates (2026 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 20, STANDARD ELECTRIC 27), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233910 ('Electrical hookups (50-amp, 30-amp or 110-volt outlets) are available at sites 12-45.') + RIDB catalog (17 sites list 50-amp), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 48 Tent/RV sites, #46-#49 tent only. recreation.gov's catalog has 49 sites (43 standard, 6 tent-only): max vehicle lengths 12-45 ft, 11 sites at 40 ft and 4 at 45; 4 pull-throughs. Sites 1-11 and 46-50 non-electric, 12-45 electric.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/arrowhead-campground ('Arrowhead Campground has 48 sites for Tent/RV camping. values.note: Dump station across from the pay station; campground host; 0.75-mile paved bike/walking loop.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233910 ('The facility also provides hot showers and flush toilets. A dump station is located across from the pay station.') + the Forest Service page (paved path), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by the Forest Service's Uwharrie Ranger District (not a concession). Sites 20 and 31 are always first-come, paid on site (cash or check, within 30 minutes of choosing a site). Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 2 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/arrowhead-campground ('Reservations can be made at recreation.gov. First come first serve sites are also available for purchase in person on a limited basis.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233910 ('Campsites 20 and 31 are always non-reservable for first come/first serve campers', is_commercially_managed false), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Access/Senior pass discount on the campsite fee of single sites only; not on double sites or the electric fee.

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233910 (notice: 'For Access or Senior Access Pass card holders, discounts only apply on the campsite fee on single sites ... Electrical hookup surcharges are not discounted'), read 2026-10-22
